source.revision_label: stable release tag v1.1.0, committed 2023-04-03. Resolved from the GitHub tags API, not inherited from a prior lock.
source.observed_head_note: Upstream main at retrieval, a 2026-07-15 CI fix. It is not a release, and the superseded main-branch runtime at models/structure/runtime/rfdiffusion pinned it instead of the tag. This runtime pins the tag the ticket requires.

base.tag_drift_note: The 2.3.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-devel tag now resolves to sha256:1bb28822b361bdb2d8cde5a58f08337490bf6e73fc96b0aa1035268c295f3d00. The digest above is pinned deliberately and is what this runtime was qualified against; the drift is why the tag is never used as a build input.

image.runtime_input_policy: Every file that enters the image is sha256-pinned here and re-verified by build_rfdiffusion.py before the build starts, so the published layers can be tied back to the checked-in runtime.

accelerator_runtime.architecture_policy: Qualified on H100 (sm90) only. torch 2.3.0/cu121 and the prebuilt DGL cu121 wheel ship a fixed set of compiled kernels and this runtime has audited neither the cubin nor the PTX they carry, so no portability claim is made for any other GPU family. Nothing in the image hard-codes a device selector, so another family needs per-family evidence rather than a code change; until that evidence exists it is unqualified. Accelerator breadth belongs in the Terraform resource profiles, not in a binary property of this image.

supersedes.reason: H100 semantic-qualified for a historical single artifact root, but the production controller mounts the immutable checkpoint separately from a tenant motif input. The r13 successor adds an explicit fail-closed request-input root; evidence cannot transfer across the new image digest.

Carries the motif superposition fix and is correctly attested (SLSA names clean commit 4885ece8), but was built before the scientific artifact localization foundation landed on main at 3a7ceb25. Superseded so the qualified candidate is built from source that already contains the accepted foundation. Its runtime inputs are byte-identical to r12's; only the source the provenance names differs.

Correctly attested (SLSA names clean commit 1b5a648b) and its design-backbone run succeeded on H100. Superseded on a false negative in its own semantic validator: motif CA RMSD was computed on raw coordinates, so RFdiffusion's recentring of the design read as motif loss. The live scaffold-motif run produced a correct structure -- all 12 motif identities preserved, upstream reporting ~0.19 A sampled motif RMSD -- but the wrapper rejected it at 47.956 A. Re-measured on those exact exported bytes, the move was a 47.96 A translation with 1.0 deg of rotation and the superposed CA RMSD is 0.1129 A. r11 measures after optimal superposition. The 1.5 A threshold was not loosened.

Correctly attested (SLSA names clean commit 76d1e7da) and genuinely H100-qualified for design-backbone on two nodes. Superseded so that one digest carries both operations: r9 has no scaffold-motif receipt, and its runtime leaked the upstream stdout pipe because Popen was not used as a context manager. r9's design-backbone evidence remains valid for r9 and does not transfer to this image.

First image of this successor. Correctly attested: its SLSA provenance names clean commit 267cce4950e020238bd6aace3621a4efc8ccbe6a. Superseded on a real defect found by its own exact-digest H100 run: the adapter did not set inference.schedule_directory_path, so upstream tried to mkdir its IGSO3 schedule cache inside the read-only /opt/rfdiffusion and died after loading the checkpoint, before any diffusion. No semantic evidence exists for this digest.

Published 2026-09-03T04:07Z by the mixed BindCraft/RFdiffusion branch as an explicit H100 candidate. Its SLSA provenance records no VCS revision at all, only local build contexts, so the image cannot be tied to any source commit. It also carries no H100 semantic evidence: the branch's semantic-validation, post-roll and scan records all still name r6.

The only prior generation with a real H100 diffusion run (76-residue backbone, 50 steps). Still refused as a source of truth: its OCI adapter label names commit 3475ce0ee8efdf2d3ccbcc65651ab11fe7cb34fe, which is a dangling object reachable from no branch or remote ref, so the identity it asserts cannot be resolved by anyone checking it out.
Pre-r6 predecessor recorded only in the superseded chain of the mixed branch's lock. No tag, no evidence and no reachable source is recorded for it anywhere in the repository.

required_environment.FS2_ARTIFACT_ROOT: root of the mounted artifact plane; defaults to /opt/fs2/artifacts
required_environment.FS2_INPUT_ARTIFACT_ROOT: root of controller-materialized request artifacts; defaults to FS2_ARTIFACT_ROOT for backward-compatible direct runs

seed_contract.detail: RFdiffusion v1.1.0 has no inference.seed. run_inference.py calls make_deterministic(i_des) per design, so the per-design seed is the design index. The adapter maps its seed onto design_startnum and records the design index that seeded each design, rather than reporting a seed it did not control.

artifact_markers.cuda_evidence: the .trb run metadata carries torch.cuda.get_device_name(); a recorded device of CPU is a failed run, not a degraded one

contract_freeze.detail: The scientific batch adapter owner is reconciling the obsolete /opt/fs2/bin/rfdiffusion-batch contract to this image's CLI and translating their typed public request into the internal rfdiffusion-parameters/v1 schema. The CLI, the internal schema and the adapter id are frozen for the duration; any change ships as a new fixture and a new adapter id, never as a redefinition. Enforced by tests/test_adapter_contract.py::FrozenContractTests.

motif_verification.measured_on: CA atoms at the positions upstream's con_ref_pdb_idx / con_hal_pdb_idx map
motif_verification.rationale: Upstream emits designs in its own recentred frame, so raw-coordinate RMSD measures where a design was placed rather than whether the motif survived. Both values are reported so a reviewer can see the size of the rigid-body move that was removed rather than having to trust that one was.

weight_policy.detail: The image carries no model weights. The upstream v1.1.0 archive ships none either, so nothing has to be deleted; the checkpoint is mounted from the artifact plane and verified by sha256 at run time.

external_artifacts.note: ActiveSite_ckpt.pt has the identical byte size, so this artifact is always matched on sha256 and never on size.
Scaffold-motif target, already carried on main as the RFdiffusion validator input. Motif A23-34 is the ubiquitin alpha-helix and has a complete N/CA/C backbone.

artifact_delivery.detail: Delivery is canonical. The accepted contract entry, the published generation, the in-generation marker and the semantic runs all agree, and a run has now consumed the generation rather than only probing it. The historical task-owned run input is retained as an archival record and is no longer a delivery path.

planes.name: public
planes.rationale: RFdiffusion code and weights are both BSD-3-Clause and the 1UBQ target is public PDB data, so this runtime needs no licence-restricted plane and never mounts one.

canonical_entry.detail: The one-file identity is intentionally separate from the eight-checkpoint rfdiffusion-checkpoints catalog identity. It contains exactly Base_ckpt.pt and its in-generation marker.

localization_owner.scope: raw single-file artifact localization, including this checkpoint
localization_owner.this_runtime_claims: The checkpoint localization was published by the single-file localization lane and is consumed here. This task added no generation of its own for RFdiffusion; it added the canonical-generation plane to the qualification renderer, the in-pod marker admission, and the semantic evidence that the generation actually feeds the qualified operations.

run_input_staging.purpose: archival exact-byte verifier for the historical r12 qualification input; canonical reruns use the shared localization generation
run_input_staging.addressing: named by the object's own catalog sha256, not by a tree-inventory generation; the digest in the path means only 'these are the bytes that hash to this'
run_input_staging.verification: sha256 and byte count both checked against the accepted catalog before use
run_input_staging.rerun_policy: do not use this helper for a new qualification; mount the canonical verified-copy generation instead

mount_contract.detail: The shared contract passes this exact directory as --artifact-root. The runtime resolves the manifest's Base_ckpt.pt beneath it and verifies its SHA-256 and byte count before use.

qualification.other_accelerators: not-qualified; each family needs its own evidence
qualification.evidence_transfer_policy: The listed evidence belongs to r12 and demonstrates the unchanged scientific path only. Nothing transfers to r13 until its immutable digest completes a production-controller run.

qualification.scope: r13 changes only checkpoint/request root separation; no semantic, throughput, contention, elasticity, multi-design, snapshot, or cold-start claim exists for the successor until it is published and run.
qualification.localization_state: The canonical generation was admitted and semantically exercised with r12 on a real H100; r13 uses the same generation but remains unqualified until its own production-controller run. See evidence/h100-canonical-generation-run-20260904.json.

upstream_contract_defects.observed: config/inference/base.yaml declares no inference.seed key, and make_deterministic(i_des) is called with the design index
upstream_contract_defects.impact: any adapter that emits inference.seed=<n> is emitting an override Hydra will reject or silently ignore, and the seed it reports is not the seed that ran
upstream_contract_defects.resolution: the adapter maps seed onto inference.design_startnum with inference.deterministic=True and reports the design index as the seed, which is what actually seeded the design

upstream_contract_defects.location: upstream 9273ef67 scripts/run_inference.py, inference.cautious defaults to True
upstream_contract_defects.observed: a design whose .pdb already exists is skipped with a log line and no error
upstream_contract_defects.impact: a re-run over a dirty output directory can exit 0 having produced nothing, and a stale file would be verified as if it were fresh
upstream_contract_defects.resolution: the adapter refuses to start unless the output directory is empty

upstream_contract_defects.observed: when inference.schedule_directory_path is unset, the schedule cache directory defaults to <package>/../../schedules and is created with os.mkdir
upstream_contract_defects.impact: under readOnlyRootFilesystem, or any image that seals its own upstream tree, the run dies with OSError EROFS after the checkpoint loads and before any diffusion step
upstream_contract_defects.resolution: the adapter always passes inference.schedule_directory_path under its writable scratch directory and creates it first. Observed live on H100 Job fs2-rfd-semantic-r8-cold; fixed for r9.

upstream_contract_defects.observed: A scaffolded motif is chemically identical to the reference but placed elsewhere in space. On the live r10 run the offset was a 47.96 A translation with 1.0 deg of rotation.
upstream_contract_defects.impact: any validator comparing raw coordinates rejects correct designs
upstream_contract_defects.resolution: motif RMSD is measured after optimal superposition; both aligned and unaligned values are recorded.

follow_ups.observed: On the true-cold run, checkpoint load plus IGSO3 schedule calculation took 28.1 s of a 67 s schedule-to-semantic-complete, against 20.1 s of actual 50-step diffusion. The schedule cache starts empty in every container because it is redirected to ephemeral scratch.
follow_ups.proposal: Preseed the deterministic IGSO3 schedules through the platform cache tier, or bake a read-only seed copy into the image and copy it into writable scratch at start. The schedules depend only on the diffuser parameters, so they are safely shareable. Never make the image root writable to achieve this.

follow_ups.detail: models/cancer-immunotherapy/runtime-images/runtime_probe.py has CONFIG entries only for proteina-complexa, boltzgen and mosaic. This runtime deliberately did not edit that shared file to avoid colliding with its active owner; it ships its own 'probe' subcommand instead. Adding an rfdiffusion entry is a one-line change for whoever owns that file.

This runtime implements fs2-serve.nebius.ai/rfdiffusion-parameters/v1 with operations design-backbone and scaffold-motif, matching the onboarding declaration. The pending batch-adapter branch instead defines rfdiffusion-upstream-base-parameters/v1 with typed contig objects. One of the two must win before the controller route is exposed; the argv contract in adapter.argv_contract is what this image actually accepts.

follow_ups.observed: ClusterQueue inference-accelerators lists inference-h100-1x first with nominal quota for two GPUs, but no Ready node carries accelerator.fs2.nebius/pool-id=h100-1x. A GPU workload admitted through the inference-models LocalQueue without pinning a pool id is assigned that flavor, injected with its node labels, and then cannot schedule; only the cluster autoscaler recovers it, by building a node.
follow_ups.impact: First-attempt scheduling latency and an avoidable node build for any scientific GPU workload that does not pin a pool id. Observed live on 2026-09-04: the pod stayed Pending with an untolerated-taint report and triggered a 0->1 scale-up of the h100-1x node group.
follow_ups.resolution: This runtime pins accelerator.fs2.nebius/pool-id so Kueue must choose the flavor whose nodes exist. The durable fix is either to give the h100-1x flavor real capacity or to order the reserved flavor first; both belong to the scheduling owner.
